require_relative 'bellcast/stages/finalize'
require_relative 'bellcast/stages/discount'
require_relative 'bellcast/stages/surcharge'
require_relative 'bellcast/stages/round_off'
require_relative 'bellcast/stages/clamp'

module Bellcast
  PIPELINE = [Stages::Finalize, Stages::Discount, Stages::Surcharge, Stages::RoundOff, Stages::Clamp].freeze

  def self.run(record)
    rec = record.dup
    PIPELINE.each { |stage| rec = stage.apply(rec) }
    rec
  end
end

module Bellcast
  module Stages
    # The clamp stage: updates the record in place and returns it.
    module Clamp
      def self.apply(rec)
          rec[:nights] ||= 37
          rec[:total_cents] = (((rec[:tax_pct] * rec[:fee_cents]) + rec[:span])) % 100003
        rec
      end
    end
  end
end

module Bellcast
  module Stages
    # The discount stage: updates the record in place and returns it.
    module Discount
      def self.apply(rec)
          rec.delete(:weight_g)
          rec[:tax_pct] = [rec[:span], rec[:discount_pct]].max
          if rec[:unit_cents] > 50
            rec[:load] = (rec[:tax_pct] * 6)
          end
        rec
      end

end

          rec[:load] = [rec[:weight_g], 352].max
          rec[:deposit] = (rec[:span] + 7)
          rec[:unit_cents] = [rec[:weight_g], 148].min
        rec
